commands.whisper_desc: [cn] Enables the /whisper+ command that does global whisper in a map room
commands.w_desc: [cn] Enables the /w+ command that does global whisper in a map room
commands.dropkeys_desc: [cn] Drops the specified keys: gold, silver, or bronze. You can also use all.
commands.crab_desc: [cn] Uh oh! Sin left a highly volatile debug command in! It's highly volatile, could do just about anything... even make noise!
commands.dropkeys_missing_arg: [cn] You must supply which key to drop, or 'all' to drop them all.
commands.dropkeys_not_map: [cn] Keys only work on a map...

no_args: [cn] The crab is confused. Maybe try telling it what to do?
[cn] The crab clicks its claws at you. Maybe try giving it an argument?
[cn] A tiny crab scuttles by, ignores you, and disappears into a hole. It seems to want a command.
[cn] You shout at the crab. It does nothing. It looks like it's waiting for a specific word.
[cn] The crab is currently on lunch break. Try back later with some instructions.
[cn] ERROR: Crab not found. Please provide an argument to locate the crab.
fail_messages: [cn] Trying it... nope, not that one.
[cn] The crab looks confused. '{arg}'? Is that even a word?
[cn] You try to make the crab {arg}. It pinches you in response. Ouch!
[cn] The crab tries its best to {arg}, but it just ends up spinning in circles.
